notes.title: UPDATE v0.1.1⚡️
notes.notes:
Hey Ninjas!

Our first update for Be The Hero has been released!
IMPORTANT NOTE: You have to update to DirectX 11 or higher to play BE THE HERO.

Fixes: 
- Score attack mode added
- Added visual marker for players to head towards after defeating a round of enemies
- Option to skip comic 
- Option to return to the main screen after ending credits
- "Harakiri" to reset player position.

We are also currently working to provide the following: 
- More enemies, and improved AI 
- Mini map on UI
- New city map
- New weapons
- Adjustments on player's attacks and movement 

We are eagerly adding a lot of suggestions given by our reviewers.  If you'd like to suggest more ideas, please don't hesitate to do so!

notes.title: An insight into our storyboarding process
notes.notes:
In order to enjoy the full experience of BE THE HERO, the player should enjoy the story portion. It is a VR Comic after all. This is why storyboarding is very important.  

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/c700be7c3e72b1316767f75ef3ba86e15bb99616.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/ce390d8bfad2b3c19211c80d64288476270f7c10.png[/img][/url] 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/50373ec036bceed54166eebc2a3ad9be21aa6847.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/c6db1dbce4c0de18be021b0a6d0d1fd9d09e134c.png[/img][/url] 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/464ad1df709c968f5b0a5a43e5ed0f9bad30ef21.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/b5e66b2f488973ff7d9b8dc76e1b24684ed93400.png[/img][/url] 

Our illustrator, Ishikawa, sits down with our producer Koji, to create these. Then the rest of the team at EXPVR reads it through, and we all discuss it as a team. Some things get added in, some thrown out, and sometimes we laugh because some rough sketches of the characters look derpy.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/88ae0b7c69ab99720d4dfcacf0243b3b8705e8d5.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/addc8bfb681595daabc1e7d2dc96d30ec282491d.png[/img][/url]

Here is an example of what a final panel looks like after the storyboard/rough draft process. Sakuya heals Kurogane after he is injured from a fight.  

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/56306c60066a894bab88a66f8425560c59d1aaa3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149356/75dee194d29ad72e36ceecd67b6e48c2233a53b6.png[/img][/url]  

These detailed storyboards also help with setting up the VR action portion of the game. Where should the player be standing so the transition from comic-to-game is smooth? Is it an interesting angle? Is the forced perspective clear?

The whole process from storyboard to the final image takes about two months per episode, but our team is learning to work faster as we all get used to the process and tools. We're hoping the future episodes will be produced quicker but with the same quality!

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Postponed Release Date
notes.notes:
Although Be The Hero was originally scheduled to be released via Steam on 11/24, we have decided to postpone the release.  

Our original plan was to give Early Access to players and adjust the game according to feedback for the full version.  However, we realized that it would be quite difficult and inefficient to fix the game that way if it's already at the stage of Early Access.  We want this game to be fun and exciting for the player, and we can't do that unless we listen to what everyone wants!  

So instead, we will be releasing what used to be "Early Access" version of the game as a "Prototype" in December.  We will make another announcement once the prototype is available, so we hope you will try it out and let us know your thoughts!

Thank You!
EXPVR Team
